column1: # Vietnamese pack, phase 1 (project owner 2026-10-13; northern standard reading).
# Declared-only: the pack never scores, classifies or owns a script in another
# request except in a Latin sentence written with Vietnamese letters.
# Letters only Vietnamese writes (ă đ ơ ư ĩ ũ and U+1EA0-U+1EF9: ạ ả ấ ệ ở ữ …). A word with one is
# strong evidence; so are the combining dot below, hook above, horn and breve.
# Letters Vietnamese shares with French, Spanish and Portuguese (é, ô, à …): a word of up to seven
# letters with one counts only when the sentence has a strong word or two such words (Tôi có mèo);
# référendum, café in a French sentence do not decide it (2026-10-13, English benchmark).
# Letters Vietnamese never writes: a sentence with one is not Vietnamese.
# French, Spanish and German words: a sentence with one and no strong letter is not Vietnamese.
# Unmarked English words that decide an English sentence in a vi-VN request.
# Words that are also Vietnamese (in, to, do, so, may, me, an, my) are left out.
# Words before a number that decide its reading (|-separated, both cases).
